bibl.title: Learning from Mistakes: Constructing Knowledge in Late Antique Mathematical Texts.
bibl.seg: Courtney A. Roby, Learning from Mistakes: Constructing Knowledge in Late Antique Mathematical Texts.
Monika Amsler (ed.), Knowledge Construction in Late Antiquity = Trends in Classics. Supplementary Volumes. 142 (Berlin - Boston, 2023) pp. 155-187, figg.
bibl.note: Analyzes problems in practical mathematics compiled in late antiquity from two sources: the newly published P. Math. (= LDAB 10719) and the Stereometrica associated with Hero of Alexandria. - 1. Introduction. - 2. Learning mathematics. - 3. Problems with problem-solving: Case study 1: faults with vaults; - Case study 2: reality breaks. - 4. Conclusion.
